role: Product manager, then Director of Marketing and Communication (France, then continental Europe)
description: Worked for 13 years in the private sector at insurer CIGNA, rising from product manager to director of marketing and communication.
Left the private sector to become deputy director general in charge of operational directions and services at the regional council.

role: Secretary of State for Integration and Equal Opportunities
organization: Government of France (Raffarin government, under minister Jean-Louis Borloo)
description: First government post, appointed under President Jacques Chirac.

role: Secretary of State for Senior Citizens
description: Junior ministerial post in charge of policy for the elderly.

role: Minister Delegate for Social Cohesion and Parity
description: Ministerial role under Prime Minister Dominique de Villepin; led 2005 measures on French-language requirements for long-term residence permits and on housing for the homeless.

role: Vice-President of the National Assembly (later First Vice-President)
description: Elected vice-president of the Assemblée nationale in 2008; served as First Vice-President from 2011 and again after 2012, also chairing internal delegations (communication/press, then international activities).
Appointed treasurer of the UMP under party chair Jean-François Copé.

role: President of the Communauté d'Agglomération Reims Métropole, then President of the Communauté urbaine du Grand Reims
description: Headed the Reims metropolitan intercommunal authority (Reims Métropole, becoming Grand Reims in 2017); re-elected in July 2020.

organization: Agence Nationale pour la Rénovation Urbaine (ANRU)
description: Appointed by presidential decree as president of the national urban renewal agency.

role: Minister of Labour, Health and Solidarity
description: Returned to national government under Prime Minister Gabriel Attal, heading a combined social super-ministry.

role: Minister of Partnership with Territories and Decentralisation
description: Held the territories/decentralisation portfolio under Prime Minister Michel Barnier.

role: Minister of Labour, Health, Solidarity and Families
organization: Government of France (Bayrou government, then first Lecornu government)
description: Headed the combined social super-ministry under Prime Minister François Bayrou; nominally reappointed in the short-lived first Lecornu government of 5-6 October 2025.

role: Minister of the Armed Forces and Veterans
description: Appointed Minister of the Armed Forces and Veterans under Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu; retained the position in the 26 February 2026 reshuffle. Has championed an updated military programming law (+36 billion euros to 2030) and a 2026 defence budget of about 57.1 billion euros.
